name: Troglodyte

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Any creature other than a troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 feet of the troglodyte must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to the stench of all troglodytes for 1 hour.

traits.name: Chameleon Skin
traits.description: The troglodyte has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troglodyte makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

tactics: Troglodytes swarm in the dark caverns, relying on Stench to weaken the party and Chameleon Skin to ambush. They fight recklessly but flee if badly outnumbered.
